title: My boss wore my old dress to the office party

voice.name: Kitty
voice.direction: sultry, smirking, brisk TikTok storytelling pace

hooks.text: My boss wore my old dress to the office party. So did I.
My boss fired a girl for sneakers. I matched her dress.
My boss bought her party dress from my closet.

hookVariants.visual: Office party: spotlight snaps onto Tiff and her boss in the same red dress, face to face. Text hook: SAME DRESS. MY BOSS.
Same line and text hook; frame 0 is a tight close-up of the key prop or screen, then a fast pull-back to Tiff.
Same line and text hook; frame 0 is Tiff's face mid-reaction (eyes wide), then a whip to the key prop.

beats.text: My boss wore my old dress to the office party. So did *I*.
beats.visual: Office party: spotlight snaps onto Tiff and her boss in the same red dress, face to face. Text hook: SAME DRESS. MY BOSS.

beats.text: Same red dress. Same *bow* on the back.
This is the woman who sent Kayla home for wearing *sneakers*.
beats.visual: Flash insert: a coworker in sneakers walking out with a box; boss pointing at the door.
Coworkers freeze mid-sip; the music drops out.

beats.text: She walked straight up to me. Not *smiling*.
beats.visual: Boss crosses the room, slow; Tiff grips her cup.

beats.text: Then she leaned in and said: I know. I bought it from *you*.
My old listing. Off my clothes *chair*.
beats.visual: Flashback: Tiff snapping the red dress off her chair pile.

beats.text: Then she asked what else I was *selling*.
So I sent her everything I'd listed with *pileGo*.
beats.visual: Tiff sends a long list; boss scrolling, eyes wide.
Four SOLD cards pop one by one.

beats.text: Still no raise. But now she calls me her *stylist*.
beats.visual: Tiff at her desk, boss walks by in another of Tiff's old outfits, thumbs up.
